public_runtime_benchmark.excluded_from_timing: package/model loading, CLI startup, input JSON file read, report writing

protocol.linear_execution: NumPy CPU only; no LR CUDA timing
protocol.throughput: batch size divided by median or p95 batch latency; not single-person service throughput

public_runtime_benchmark.scope: seven prespecified fold1 full-expanded BCE examples, not full-cohort refits
public_runtime_benchmark.timed_operation: ClinicalV22Predictor.infer(raw38): validate, engineered114, model, calibration, union/state risk, threshold decisions

resource_execution.fit_seconds_scope: mixed device and resource conditions; execution time, not a controlled same-hardware comparison
resource_execution.prior_launch: two auto workers; CPU small EPF/MLP and CUDA large EPF observed
resource_execution.saved_cpu_resume_count_source: root execution handoff; original-device rule is in RESOURCE_POLICY.json
resource_execution.saved_resume_policy: Continue on recorded original device only

limitations: Separate five-input Korean-to-US substudy, not direct validation of v21 full19/engineered models
US DIQ010=2 excludes borderline=3, while Korean DE1_dg=0 may include previously diagnosed prediabetes
Survey, pregnancy, medication questionnaire, blood-pressure and triglyceride measurement rules differ by country
No US label informed Korean model selection, calibration, or threshold; US screening decision metrics are undefined

uncertainty.interpretation: conditional on fixed trained models; no training or model-selection uncertainty
uncertainty.method: full-frame stratified Rao-Wu-style PSU resampling; fixed Korean models

external_common_core.weight_definition: NHANES August 2021-August 2023 fasting subsample WTSAF2YR; GLU/TRIGLY weights matched

aggregate.multiplicity: Only stated contrasts receive intervals; all other policy results are descriptive point estimates

paired_full_frame_PSU.interpretation: Fixed-prediction conditional paired PSU intervals; not seed variability or a distribution-free claim

survey_audit.method: n_h-1 draws with replacement; multiplicity*n_h/(n_h-1); full survey PSUs; no FPC

aggregate.scope: five-fold fixed OOF; ten model IDs; 13-view unit results; no retraining

v21_ensemble_policy.comparison: Ensemble probability score versus frozen mean-of-single-seed scores; distinct estimands

uncertainty.condition: fixed OOF predictions; excludes refitting, selection and repeated-study uncertainty
uncertainty.domain_mapping: same PSU multiplier on full wt_itvex and nutrition wt_tot rows
uncertainty.multiplicity: 16-contrast max-|T| interval is a conditional approximation, not a coverage guarantee

survey_frame.method: n_h-1 draws with replacement; multiplicity*n_h/(n_h-1); full survey PSUs; no FPC
